svg.title: Agent-Assisted Closed-Loop Harness for B200 Kernel Optimization
svg.desc: Editable vector reconstruction, original-style typography revision 3. Canvas: 1672 by 941. All 85 original labels are live SVG text, with native Roboto / Roboto Condensed font proportions. Text and its ancestor groups have no transforms; no forced text lengths or glyph stretching. Typography is consistent by semantic role. Original figure content, colors, icons, arrows and flow relationships are retained. Step 7 has a 16.2-pixel wider card so its native text does not need compression. Fonts are not embedded; install Roboto and Roboto Condensed locally for matching editable rendering.

07 · Conservative acceptance rule
g.text: promote only when the full workload distribution improves and correctness is preserved.
